facts.fact: The national digitalisation strategy lists as initiative 1.1.8 the drafting of a sector policy letter for the digital sector, led by MPTEN with the executive, costed at USD 50 thousand over 6 months; the document gives no date for it, so its published date 2024-06-11 is used.
facts.system: lettre de politique sectorielle du numerique

note: The document is the national digital strategy (Guinee Digitale 2023-2027), class national, so only the sector policy letter it announces gives a fact.
